name: Ben Schmitz
headline: President & Founder
about: Serial entrepreneur with multiple successful attempts and even more unsuccessful attempts. Philosophy education and background in military leadership. Passion for impacting the world through community founding. Proven business and non-profit leader.

experiences.description: I am the sole founder of a construction and real estate development company focused on improving the built environment by designing and building residential neighborhoods with four key principles: Community, Corporeal Good, Beauty, and Durability. Our New Urbanist design elements combined with community homestead/farm-to-table elements provide the basis for Shire Group's urban planning. Our signature custom-built structural stone houses ensure the unmatched beauty and durability of our neighborhoods.

I led a group of men to establish a non-profit called the Brotherhood of Saint Joseph with the sponsorship of Anchor Group and, later, Shire Group. The Brotherhood is a lay, Catholic, fraternal community which commits to a shared life of prayer, work, formation, and brotherly aid. My businesses serve as hosts to the Brotherhood, allowing and enabling the members that are employed at my businesses to participate in the daily life of prayer, work, and formation.

I am the sole founder of Anchor Group in 2018 and currently serve as it's President. Began as a self-employed NetSuite architect and consultant, then hired and trained consultants, then built and trained a team of true professionals specializing in NetSuite and achieved Alliance Partner status with Oracle. Today, Anchor Group is a pioneer in the NetSuite consulting space and in many areas, leading the whole  NetSuite community toward powerful and professional NetSuite implementation.

At Anchor Group, we strive to be the gold standard in NetSuite and SuiteCommerce consulting. We invest in virtuous employees and then work tirelessly to form them in technical mastery, servant leadership, conscious responsibility, and a focus on the family. In doing so, we are able to deliver sound counsel, sustainable solutions, and a world-class customer experience.

Writing Battalion OPORDS, tasking subordinate units, coordinating Battalion training, establishing SOPs, and tracking unit readiness across the battalion.

I served on several domestic deployments including leading D Co, 173rd BEB, 32nd IBCT elements in defense of the capitol (Madison, WI) during the unrest surrounding the George Floyd and Jacob Blake/Kenosha protests. During the George Floyd protests, I was the highest ranking National Guard officer on the ground.

Platoon Leader of 35+ Soldiers in a drone reconnaissance unit in the Wisconsin National Guard. Responsible for planning, coordinating, and leading Soldiers in training for wartime operations.

Led numerous high-risk domestic missions during 2020, including several riot response missions with extremely high public visibility requiring utmost sensitivity to public climate, combined with rapidly developing and challenging security threats.

Responsible for overseeing logistics, communication, training, welfare of Soldiers, and administrative readiness.  Regular coordination with Battalion-level and Brigade-level assets to conduct large scale training/simulated combat operations (1000+ Soldiers). Responsible for organizing troop mobilization for foreign deployments and domestic missions.

Platoon Leader of 25+ Soldiers in a specialized sniper and reconnaissance unit in the Wisconsin National Guard. Responsible for planning, coordinating, and leading Soldiers in training for wartime operations. Coordinated mobilization of Soldiers for hurricane and flood relief.

Second in command of a 120 Soldier Infantry Company in the Wisconsin Army National Guard.  Responsible for overseeing company logistics, internal communication, training, welfare of Soldiers, and administrative readiness.  Coordinated with Battalion and Brigade-level assets to conduct large scale training/simulated combat operations (1000+ Soldiers).

Platoon Leader in the Wisconsin National Guard. Responsible for training, equipping, and leading 40+ Infantry Soldiers.  Gained invaluable experience and learned through intense study of the operations process, direct leadership, training management, tactical awareness, and successful communication in challenging, high risk environments.
